mechanical_height_audit.conclusion: Known fixed central compute/power/RF parts remain <=3.25 mm and pass the 6.5 mm gross cavity screen. External connector screening changes the mechanical verdict: USB-A has effectively zero gross tolerance margin, the screened Micro-Fit power header needs more than 6.5 mm under the conservative screen, and the screened right-angle RCA family is the dominant ~10 mm Z driver. The 6 mm legacy standoff/Z-stack therefore remains candidate-only until local perimeter relief or an alternate connector strategy is proven.

rca_integration_strategy.decision: Prefer two individual main-PCB right-angle RCA jacks if local perimeter/module relief proves the bodies and mating plugs fit. Fall back to panel-mounted wired RCA only if that proof fails.

reasons: individual jacks can preserve the 19.20 mm legacy RCA center spacing
Ø8.3 mm barrel is geometrically compatible with the recorded Ø11.88 mm legacy aperture on first-order concentric screening
keeps MAIN L/R on the mainboard with no internal audio harness
current non-gold red/white variants are active distributor-listed parts
